title: page loaded as https://RP-A.TEST with the default RP ID

unsafe.definition: a passkey stored under "RP-A.TEST" instead of "rp-a.test", or clientDataJSON.origin not equal to https://rp-a.test

note: URL host parser lowercases (domain to ASCII), so origin is https://rp-a.test and the default rpId (L3 §5.1.3: effective domain) is rp-a.test; the RP expects exactly those.
